tech.title: Trump sealed deal for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
tech.summary: President Trump made a personal promise that Jensen Huang had not broken national security laws. The sharp stock price drop after his resignation and questions about the leadership of the interim CEO also spurred the board's decision. Nvidia's newly appointed board chair had previously stated that the board did not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO. Trump believes his administration's close working relationship with Huang gives the US its best opportunity to protect national security and prevent cutting-edge AI chips from reaching banned customers.

tech.title: OpenAI Staffer Likely Captured Secrets on Hidden Bug, US Says
tech.summary: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former engineer at OpenAI, has pleaded not guilty to an eavesdropping charge for bugging an office conference room, likely to intercept trade secrets. He has requested bail, but there are concerns that he may try to flee before trial given his relatively weak ties to the US and the considerable resources and connections he has to Saudi Arabia. The government has so far located hundreds of audio files on Alfozan's computer, many of which involve discussions of what may be trade secrets. He appears to have uploaded at least some of the recordings to Dropbox.

tech.title: The Incredible, Elegant DNA Repair System Makes Gene Editing Work
tech.summary: Cells have a native repair mechanism for DNA that recognizes and replaces faulty DNA before lasting damage or dysfunction can set in. This ability evolved essentially at the same time as DNA, as it is impossible to have stable genetic information without DNA repair. The mechanisms are essential to the evolutionary lineage of all known life. Scientists and doctors experimenting with gene editing use these natural self-editing and repair tools to insert, delete, or mutate genes to study and treat disease.

tech.title: Tesla FSD v15 is AI4's last shot as Musk reveals how little compute is left
tech.summary: Tesla's FSD v15 is the company's last real shot at delivering unsupervised self-driving on the AI4 computer. The next-gen A15 chip will not be coming to cars, and the mid-cycle AI4.5 upgrade had its RAM cut from 32GB to 24GB. The mid-cycle refresh exists mainly because Tesla needs a new memory type it can actually buy. The cost of the AI4 chip is now twice as much due to memory and storage price hikes.

marketing.title: Participation in Black Friday-Cyber Monday Shopping Expected to Hit 10-year High
marketing.summary: Deloitte reports that 87% of consumers plan to shop during BFCM this year, with average spending flat at $624. Gen Z leads with 94% planning to participate and $752 in expected spending, up 23% year over year. Social media and GenAI use are linked to higher spending, with shoppers using both expecting to spend 61% more than those using neither. Meanwhile, 72% are delaying some purchases in anticipation of better deals.

marketing.title: AI citations to social media & UGC grew 52% on Google's AI platforms, fell 44% on ChatGPT
marketing.summary: Citations to 18 UGC domains grew 52% across Google's AI platforms from January to August, but fell 44% on ChatGPT. YouTube led AI Overviews with 45% of tracked citations, while Reddit dominated ChatGPT at 52%. 17 of 18 sites gained citations on AI Overviews, while 12 lost citations on ChatGPT. TikTok saw the strongest growth across both. Despite low AI referral traffic of just 0.14%, UGC can shape brand visibility in AI answers. Citation patterns vary by category, making it important to identify which sources AI platforms reference most in your market.

Install ad pixels for retargeting and conversion tracking. Identify high-intent search and AI queries such as competitor comparisons and pricing. Target these through SEO, AEO, and paid search while organic rankings build.

marketing.title: How to make high-quality AI ads
marketing.summary: AI ads start with a product selling point and a customer pain point. Build a short story around one feature that solves a real problem, then test the hardest shot before generating the rest. AI reels often use a recognizable situation, an unusual opening frame, and a single product-focused payoff, usually within 15-30 seconds. Control the output by specifying shot sizes and color grading in consistent language. Generate short clips, make pacing and text adjustments in the edit, and change one prompt variable at a time.

marketing.title: New HubSpot data reveals how mentions and citations relate on the AI engine level
marketing.summary: Model releases now swing AI visibility the way algorithm updates once swung SEO. After an update to ChatGPT on August 6, cited URLs per prompt rose 51% and domain-specific searches rose 45x. Gemini's 3.7 Flash release cut citations per prompt 27% the same week it launched. Perplexity went the other way, doubling cited URLs per answer to about 18 while referral traffic fell 14%. Sources shifted too, with ChatGPT citing competitor sites more and forums and videos far less.

marketing.title: Can we design emotional loyalty?
marketing.summary: An emotional loyalty map treats loyalty as a series of moments, each with a specific emotion to design for. For every moment, from opening the app to a service failure, it compares what the member feels now with what they should feel and picks an action to close that gap. A new member opening the app may feel confused, so showing clear progress toward the next reward leaves them informed and motivated. After a service failure, the goal is reassurance, which comes from a fast fix and a reply that recognizes their membership.
